description: Choose a telemetry view by the question you need to answer.

options.content: **Start with Run Overview** to check that data is arriving, then open the view that matches the symptom. Set cluster, node, run, and time there. Other dashboards reuse this context; Run Logs may need a different run directory name. Node and shared-service metrics can include other workloads.

Check exporter status, sample freshness, GPU utilization, and the latest completed step.

[Open Run Overview](/d/telemetry-overview)

Compare completed VERL stage times with rollout queue, KV cache, and GPU activity.

[Open Agent RL Stage Correlation](/d/agent-rl-stage-correlation)

Inspect GPU power, clock, process memory, Ethernet, and RDMA on the selected nodes.

[Open Compute & Communication](/d/xlayer-compute-communication)

Compare device I/O and filesystem mounts; inspect topology and optional SSD health.

[Open Data & Storage](/d/xlayer-data-storage)

Search node-local run logs in the selected interval. This view needs Loki.

[Open Run Logs](/d/xlayer-run-logs)

Inspect stage times with node-by-node resource samples and logs, then compare another step. Start the self-hosted Step Explorer first.

[Open Step Explorer](http://127.0.0.1:8765/)
